posts.zh:
terminal 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9891cc876d8e8c3eadad.html
posts.en:
terminal is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9891cc876d8e8c3eadad.html
